```{r}
library(gurobi)
library(tidyverse)
library(Matrix)
library(viridis)
```

```{r}
# This example formulates and solves the following simple LP model:
#  maximize
#        price*Area*y - cost (x) - cost (e)
#  subject to
#        mm/1000 *   Area       = x
#             0.20*x*1000/Area = y + 2.000
#            x * pump = e



#mm water depth conversion to m mm / 1000 Area (ha) * 10000 = 10 * mm = m^3
#cost per m^3 $5 / 1000 gal * 1 gal / 3.78541 L * 1000 L / 1 m^3 = $1.32 / m^3
#https://todayshomeowner.com/calculating-lawn-irrigation-costs/
#Wheat $200 / mton
#https://markets.businessinsider.com/commodities/wheat-price
#200 kWh / kL
#https://www.pumpindustry.com.au/measuring-pumping-costs-for-electric-irrigation-pumps
# $0.12 / kWh
#Price $200 / ton * 10000 m^3 (1 ha) = $2,000,000 / kg * m^2
model <- list()



model$A          <- matrix(c(-1,2000,0,0,2000000,-1), nrow=2, byrow=T)
model$obj        <- c(200,-13200,-0.12)
model$modelsense <- 'max'
model$rhs        <- c(400,0)
model$sense      <- c('=', '=')
model$ub         <- c(Inf,.6,Inf)

result <- gurobi(model)

#print(model$A)
#print(result$objval)
#print(result$x)

print('model parameters:')
model
print('results:')
result


# Clear space
rm(result, params, model)
```
```{r}
# This example formulates and solves the following simple LP model:
#  maximize
#        price*Area*(-0.0002164*x^2+0.329x - 5.8556) - cost (x) - cost (e)
#  subject to
#        mm/1000 *   Area       = x
#             0.20*x*1000/Area = y + 2.000
#            x * pump = e



#mm water depth conversion to m mm / 1000 Area (ha) * 10000 = 10 * mm = m^3
#cost per m^3 $5 / 1000 gal * 1 gal / 3.78541 L * 1000 L / 1 m^3 = $1.32 / m^3
#https://todayshomeowner.com/calculating-lawn-irrigation-costs/
#Wheat $200 / mton
#https://markets.businessinsider.com/commodities/wheat-price
#200 kWh / kL
#https://www.pumpindustry.com.au/measuring-pumping-costs-for-electric-irrigation-pumps
# $0.12 / kWh
model <- list()



model$A          <- matrix(c(-1,0.20,0,0,200,-1), nrow=2, byrow=T)
#model$Q     <- matrix(c(1,1,0,0,1,1,0,0,1), nrow=3, byrow=T)
model$obj        <- c(200,1.32,0.12)
model$modelsense <- 'max'
model$rhs        <- c(2,0)
model$sense      <- c('=', '=')
model$ub         <- c(6,Inf,Inf)

result <- gurobi(model)

#print(model$A)
#print(result$objval)
#print(result$x)

print('model parameters:')
model
print('results:')
result


# Clear space
rm(result, params, model)
```

```{r}
linear = function(x,p){3200*p - 500 - 7260*x}
linear1 = function(x,c){812.8 - 500 + 2740*x - c*10000*x}
p1 <- ggplot(data.frame(x=c(0, 0.4)), aes(x=x)) + 
  stat_function(fun=linear, n = 1000, args = list(p = 0.25), aes(colour = '10 inches (0.25 meters)'))+
  stat_function(fun=linear, n = 1000, args = list(p = 0.30), aes(colour = '12 inches'))+
  stat_function(fun=linear, n = 1000, args = list(p = 0.35), aes(colour = '14 inches'))+
  stat_function(fun=linear, n = 1000, args = list(p = 0.40), aes(colour = '16 inches'))+
  stat_function(fun=linear, n = 1000, args = list(p = 0.45), aes(colour = '18 inches (0.45 meters)'))+
  scale_color_viridis("Profit", discrete = TRUE, option = 'D') +
  labs(x = 'Water Depth (m)')+
  labs(y = 'Profit ($)')+
  labs(title = 'Profit vs Depth of Water Linear Function (Cost of Water = $1/m^3)')+
   ylim(-3000,1000)+
  theme_minimal()
  #scale_colour_manual("Preciptation Level", values = c("red", "blue", "green", "yellow", "brown"))

p1

ggsave('linear.png')

p1a <- ggplot(data.frame(x=c(0, 0.4)), aes(x=x)) + 
  stat_function(fun=linear1, n = 1000, args = list(c = 0.25), aes(colour = '$0.25/m^3'))+
  stat_function(fun=linear1, n = 1000, args = list(c = 0.50), aes(colour = '$0.50/m^3'))+
  stat_function(fun=linear1, n = 1000, args = list(c = 0.75), aes(colour = '$0.75/m^3'))+
  stat_function(fun=linear1, n = 1000, args = list(c = 1), aes(colour = '$1.00/m^3'))+
  stat_function(fun=linear1, n = 1000, args = list(c = 1.25), aes(colour = '$1.25/m^3'))+
   scale_color_viridis("Profit", discrete = TRUE, option = 'D') +
  labs(x = 'Water Depth (m)')+
  labs(y = 'Profit ($)')+
  labs(title = 'Profit vs Depth of Water Linear Function (Precipitation = 10 inches)')+
   ylim(-3000,1000)+
  theme_minimal()
 

p1a


ggsave('linear1.png')


  
  
```

```{r}

quadratic = function(x,p){- 4368 * (x+p)^2 + 6580 * p - 3879*x - 1171 }
quadratic1 = function(x,c){- 4368 * (x+0.254)^2 + 6580 * 0.254 + 6120*x - c*10000*x - 1171 }
p2 <- ggplot(data.frame(x=c(0, 0.4)), aes(x=x)) + 
  stat_function(fun=quadratic, n = 1000, args = list(p = 0.25), aes(colour = '10 inches (0.25 meters)'))+
  stat_function(fun=quadratic, n = 1000, args = list(p = 0.30), aes(colour = '12 inches'))+
  stat_function(fun=quadratic, n = 1000, args = list(p = 0.35), aes(colour = '14 inches'))+

p2

  stat_function(fun=quadratic1, n = 1000, args = list(c = 1.25), aes(colour = '$1.25/m^3'))+
```

```{r}
#25,625 – 21840 * x ^ 2 – 30,495 *x  - 5125 * F + 4368 * F * x^2 + 6099 * F * x

z3 = function(x, a){a*(216.4  - 4368 * x^2 - 6099*x)}
x <- rep(seq(0,0.5,0.005), each = 101)

#Checks length of f to determine how much to put in the each for x, similiar function for x to f
length(seq(-20,20,0.25))

a <- rep(c(seq(0,25,0.25)),101)
cost <- z3(x,a)
dfz3 <- data.frame("Profit" = cost, "Water Depth" = x, "Land Area" = a)
dfz3

z4 = function(x, a){a*(- 4368 * (x+0.254)^2 + 6580 * 0.254 + 6120*x - 0.25*10000*x - 1171)}
x <- rep(seq(0,0.5,0.005), each = 101)

#Checks length of f to determine how much to put in the each for x, similiar function for x to f
length(seq(-20,20,0.25))

a <- rep(c(seq(0,25,0.25)),101)
cost <- z4(x,a)
dfz4 <- data.frame("Profit" = cost, "Water Depth" = x, "Land Area" = a)
dfz4



```

```{r}

p3 <- ggplot(dfz3, aes(x = Water.Depth, y = Land.Area, z = Profit, colour = ..level.. )) +
        # stat_contour() 
  stat_contour(breaks = quantile(dfz3$Profit, seq(0, 1, 0.05)), size = 1.5) +
```
